notes.title: Small Update Post-DreamHack Dallas (06/06/2025)
notes.content:
Hello knights!

We got busy working on some fixes and changes after attending DreamHack Dallas recently. Showing the game at a large expo was exciting, a little crazy, and quite tiring. 

Anyways, we found a few issues and changed a couple things based on watching over 100 people play the game in front of our very eyes and talking with them about their thoughts. We also started getting some ideas on the general direction we want to go to get to a 1.0 release, which we’re still having discussions about, but is slowly becoming clearer as time goes on.

Below are the changes we made for this latest update.

[b]Bugs:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed issues where playing the Goblin Cave stage would cause a crash if not playing on Easy
[*] Fixed first person camera clipping while wearing certain cosmetics
[*] Fixed collider in the Castle stage that could push players into the top of the castle
[*] Fixed areas that would prevent new enemy spawns in the Castle stage
[*] Fixed certain spell sounds being disconnected from the sound mixer
[*] Added missing dust particles to kart drifts while in races
[/list]

[b]Gameplay Changes/Additions[/b]

[list]
[*] Changed all difficulties to 5 minute of play times instead of 5,7, and 9 minutes to make jumping into more challenging runs less painful on players patience
[*] With the shortening of overall time, we also decided to have challenges unlock after 30 seconds of starting a stage instead of 1 minute
[*] Change color of timer when the stage is coming to an end
[*] Added “Laser Attack” indicator for the Dungeon stage boss
[*] Added text once challenges were complete (for either successfully completing or failing)
[*] Added text after successfully completing a stage
[*] Stage exits are more clearly defined with beams of light to prevent players from wandering around after a level unsure of where to go (some of those stage exists were not as noticeable as we thought)
[*] Added transparency over time and size scaling to Magic spells to increase visibility
[*] Added boost potion to refill boost while in stages much like health potions do for health
[*] Adjusted Boost use over time in races not matching use over time in levels
[/list]
We are always looking for feedback on what we’re doing for the game, and if you can find time to fill out the feedback form (OR more importantly, if you can leave a small Steam review), it would be very much appreciated by this humble 2-man team.

If you find any bugs or technical issues, please feel free to reach out either in the Steam forums, by using our bug reporting form on our website, or even through our social media pages.

We appreciate your support and hope you continue to enjoy slaughtering monsters while we improve the experience as best we can. 

Alright, that’s all for now. Until next time!

- Zach

P.S.
For those who bought the game after seeing our ugly mugs at the expo, thank you so much! You made the event one to remember! :D

notes.title: Updates and Bugfixes before taking our game to DreamHack Dallas! (5/19/2025)
notes.content:
Hello knights!

We've been busy gearing up to show our game at an expo called DreamHack Dallas, which is from May 23rd to the 25th. This had us doing a lot of work for the game that wasn't directly working on the game (if that makes sense), BUT we've slowly been improving some small things here and there. 

Below are the fixes and changes that we implemented on this latest update.

[b]Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Enemy added to Forest stage (was missing from the last big update)
[*] Camera boundary art issue fixed for Dungeon Stage
[*] Fixed enemies surviving after boss battle in the Cemetery stage
[*] Fixed Goblin Boss Stalactite attack going off during ending cinematic when attack was started before defeat
[*] Fixed issue where the Jump skill would sometimes be triggered when jumping from a grind
[*] Sound effect connected to Great sword removed (was super loud)
[/list]

[b]General Game Updates:[/b]

[list]
[*] The UI now turns off during cinematics for a better viewing experience
[*] Traps in the Dungeon stage now instantly kill enemies
[*] Made harder enemies drop more gold and easier enemies drop less gold
[*] Cost of level 1, level 2, and level 3 weapons lowered to get players better equipment earlier in their playthrough
[*] Added “Pause Timer” drift pads during races
[*] Added 2 new types of challenges that can appear in each stage
[*] Added a progress bar and a skip button to the tutorial video
[*] Added dust particles to drifts
[/list]

We plan on implementing some some Quality of Life updates soon as well, such as improving the audio and video options panel a bit, but I'll wait until it's ready to go into details about all that.

Feel free to reach out if you experience any issues so we can try to resolve them and we would very much appreciate any feedback/reviews you can muster! I know time is precious, but it really does help the visibility of little games like ours on Steam, but of course, it's ultimately your choice.

Thank you for sticking with us, playing our game, and we hope your having fun with it!

Alright, that’s all for now. Until next time!

- Zach

notes.title: The Big March Update!
notes.content:
Hello knights!

As promised last week, we are finally unleashing the newest update to Carnage Kart X!

Below is a detailed list of almost everything included in this update (though I may have forgotten a couple small details here and there), but it’s a fairly thorough overview of the changes for those interested.

[b]Content Update List:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 3 new stages and accompanying races as well as a new way of unlocking stages based on achievements in the game
[*] Updated the previously included stages with new textures, enemies, and general flow of gameplay (some more than others)
[*] Added cosmetic items that can be unlocked by achieving different gameplay milestones in the game (example: achieving a certain amount of kills, certain amount of races completed, etc)
[*] Added multiple new enemies to stages
[*] Updated Racer AI to improve the racing experience
[*] Lowered time that the reward wheel stays on screen and the accuracy of the visuals for the amount of gold on said wheel
[*] Changed particle size and duration of chest prizes to improve visibility when getting challenge rewards
[*] Changed portal color of enemy spawn-in to improve visibility overall
[*] Changed blood VFX particles to go transparent over time to help visibility for both normal and low blood options
[*] Flipped image of controller in the “Controls” menu to make a little more sense
[*] Increased speed of data summation after stages
[*] Increased Fire rate of the base magic and bow weapons
[/list]
[b]Fixes List:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed blooming of light in the Dungeon stage and in challenges
[*] Dungeon Stage enemy racers no longer getting stuck on the bridges
[*] Fixed “Shard Acquired” text typo and it getting stuck on screen when pausing
[*] Dead zone in Cemetery level where no spawns were occurring fixed
[*] Fixed camera spinning issue when using spin attack while using different camera perspectives
[*] Sound effect fixes for the totem missiles
[*] Made triangle grind challenge a little more realistically completable
[/list]
This update had a focus of adding content to play through, making unlocking levels more compelling, and improving visibility for players while maintaining the chunk-tastic experience of clobbering through hordes of enemies, all while fixing technical bugs found.

We’d like to thank everyone who played the initial release, giving feedback about their experience and letting us know what we’re doing right, what we could improve on, and what could be done in the future. We can’t implement every suggestion of course, and some changes take longer/are more difficult than others, but ALL feedback is welcome, appreciated, and definitely helped shape the update and the improvements we included in today.

So please enjoy the update and feel free to keep letting us know your thoughts!

Alright, that’s all for now. Until next time!

- Zach

notes.title: Small Update 1/9/2025
notes.content:
Happy New Years Knights!

Hope all is well with you and yours! Thanks to some streamers and some great feedback, we found a few bugs and changed a couple things to improve a couple aspects of the game, which I will now list below!

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where players could go into Soul Shard debt buying jump skills
[*] Fixed main menu button not working with mouse after races
[*] Fixed enemy racers getting stuck doing donuts during a race
[/list]
Changes:
[list]
[*] Speaking of enemy racers, we changed the way their speed is determined to scale with the players speed, so you shouldn't get paired with a late-game speedster anymore, though they still have a good chance of being a little faster (so use that boost!)
[*] Axe now cuts grass like other secondary weapons
[/list]
Notes and Upcoming: 
There are still a couple issues with the races and path finding we're working on, but we wanted to push this little update so people didn't have to use the "Tab out" fix if using a mouse (Though we really do appreciate people sharing workarounds in the discussions!)

We've already started working on new content for the game, as well as making plans on how to implement some of the suggestions that we've received in comments and in the feedback form. Obviously, we can't do everything proposed, but it really does help give us ideas of where to go and what to focus our development time on.

Thank you to everybody who's playing the game and giving feedback! We appreciate you all!

Until next time!

-Zach

notes.title: First Updates 12/20/24
notes.content:
Hello! Thank you for being a part of our first week of Early Access!

We got some great feedback and watched some gameplay that gave us insight on a few initial bugs/visual bugs, though fortunately, no outright crashes were reported or seen, which we consider a win! Because of the upcoming holidays, we've decided to only tackle technical issues/bugs and a little QOL stuff before working on content updates, but don't worry, we'll be starting on that soon! :)

Below are the specific updates to the build(s) for this update:

[b]Demo Build:[/b]
[list]
[*] Main menu updated with blood settings
[*] Demo Race updated with better lighting
[*] Master Volume in the demo should start at 20 percent (volume when starting a video game is a meme and we're trying to be the change we want to see in the world)
[*] Gameplay tutorial video added before players start for the first time
[/list]
[b]Early Access Build[/b]
[list]
[*] Cloud Saving officially enabled (tested with multiple PCs/Steamdeck and saves are being updated)
[*] Players can only engage one activity at a time
[*] Bonus Race placement should be updating correctly (mostly, still going to improve on this in the future, but placement should be correct at the finish line)
[*] Some Sound FX were not connected to the SFX channel, causing very loud SFX to go off. 
[*] Updated turning animation of player to not engage as easily if players are pushing forward on the joystick
[*] Grind activities were spawning off center, should be corrected now
[*] Grind activity UI had some visual bugs sometimes that should be corrected now
[*] Boost lines should turn off during cinematics
[*] Boss Enemy ATK animations were disconnecting during play. That should be fixed and ATKs updated slightly (The boss may be a little harder now... good luck!)
[/list]
Thank you again to everyone who hopped on this first week of release! We appreciate you so much!

If you have any technical issues or opinions on the game so far, please feel free to fill out a feedback form! There is a separate bug report form in the feedback form (keeping it separate helps us to keep track of technical issues).

I know it's a lot to ask, but we would love to see more people leave a review of our game. Steam games live and die based on how quickly they get their first 10 reviews, so if you find the time, we would appreciate it immensely! (no pressure though, we love ya either way!)

Thank you again and Happy Holidays to you and yours!

Zach
Two Brain Games
